title: Webhook Authentication
description: Legacy Bearer or HMAC-SHA256 authentication for webhook delivery (A2A-compatible). Deprecated and removed in AdCP 4.0; new integrations omit it and use the RFC 9421 webhook signing profile.

schemes.description: Array of authentication schemes. ['Bearer'] for simple token auth, ['HMAC-SHA256'] for legacy shared-secret signing. Both are deprecated; new integrations SHOULD use the RFC 9421 webhook signing profile instead.

credentials.description: Credentials for the legacy scheme. For Bearer: token sent in Authorization header. For HMAC-SHA256: shared secret used to generate signature. Minimum 32 characters. Exchanged out-of-band during onboarding.
